questions.text: Unit `slugify(text) -> str`: Returns a URL-safe string containing only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, with words in original order and no leading or trailing hyphens
questions.gloss: Returns a URL-safe string containing only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, with words in original order and no leading or trailing hyphens

carried.argument: `A-0003` says to replace each non-alphanumeric character with a space, but it never defines whether "alphanumeric" is ASCII-only or Unicode-aware. In Python, `str.isalnum()` treats many non-ASCII letters as alphanumeric, which would preserve them and violate `C-0013`'s output charset while also conflicting with `C-0021`'s requirement that non-ASCII input not be transliterated. The contract needs an explicit ASCII-only rule here so implementers do not diverge.
